snippet.title: PinRogue Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4465650/PinRogue/

PinRogue is a pinball roguelike. Build up points and multiplier by hitting bumpers, score satisfying combos, purchase powerful upgrades in the shop and create game-breaking builds!
